quests.name: Take Up Arms
quests.plugin: Skyrim.esm (last edited by LoreRim - Dialogue Patch.esp)
quests.canDoWhy: Ask one of the Companions in Jorrvaskr about joining and they send you to Kodlak Whitemane.

starts.who: Aela the Huntress, Farkas, Skjor or Vilkas
starts.where: Jorrvaskr, Whiterun. They eat in the main hall (Aela and Skjor 10 am to 1 pm, Farkas 1 to 4 pm, Vilkas 7 to 10 pm), train for several hours a day (Farkas in the morning, the others in the afternoon), otherwise move about Jorrvaskr, and sleep downstairs in the living quarters.
starts.how: Ask about joining; they tell you to find Kodlak, who is in his quarters downstairs at the end of the hall in Jorrvaskr.

starts.where: his quarters, downstairs at the end of the hall in Jorrvaskr, Whiterun; he eats in Jorrvaskr from 6 to 8 pm
starts.how: Speak to him; he agrees to let you join if you handle some first tasks.

quests.firstStep: Speak to Kodlak Whitemane in Jorrvaskr

takesYou.why: give Vilkas' sword to Eorlund Gray-Mane, who works there from 8 am to 9 pm

objectives: Spar with Vilkas in the training yard behind Jorrvaskr
Give Vilkas' sword to Forgemaster Eorlund Grey-Mane, at the Skyforge

rewards.what: Membership in the Companions, with a bed in Jorrvaskr

opens: work for the Companions (Animal Extermination, Animal Pelt Collection and the other jobs)

people.name: Kodlak Whitemane
people.role: Harbinger of the Companions; lets you join

people.name: Vilkas
people.role: spars with you in the training yard

people.name: Eorlund Gray-Mane
people.role: forgemaster at the Skyforge; takes Vilkas' sword

people.name: Aela the Huntress
people.role: gets her repaired shield back

people.name: Farkas
people.role: shows you to your quarters

people.name: Skjor
people.role: can point you to Kodlak

unsure.why: Narrative Gameplay Consistent Dialogue Tweaks puts a check on four opening lines (named for Aela's welcome): one of One-Handed, Two-Handed, Archery or Block at 30 or more, or Health or Stamina at 150 or more. Companions Dialogue Bundle takes it off and LoreRim - Dialogue Patch, later in load order, puts it back. The same mod adds two lines that only play if you're below all those marks and haven't finished The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller, Kindred Judgment, At the Summit of Apocrypha or Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!, which looks like a brush-off for untested newcomers that those quests let you skip. The line text isn't in these files, so whether this stops you joining is unsettled; Farkas, Skjor and Vilkas also have lines that send you to Kodlak.
Vilkas Spar Skip.esp loosens the conditions on a line tied to the spar with Vilkas, which suggests a way to skip the fight; the line text isn't in these files.

The Companions' shared script lists gold, Beast Form, Beastblood and a disabled Ring of Hircine power, and Companions Dialogue Bundle adds an 'Inspired' spell from Skjor's advice; none of these is tied to finishing this quest in the records. Vilkas's Sword and Aela's Shield are the quest items you carry.
The schedules send them to a training spot the records don't name (it's a marker, not a place); the yard behind Jorrvaskr, where Vilkas spars, is the likely spot.
